batch_strategy: Structured local response surfaces combining threshold-focused condition sweeps, matched loading contrasts, endpoint-asymmetry repair, and transfer anchors for chemically distinct late-tail scaffolds.

choices.reason: Tests whether the severe m216 late-retention regime begins before the 10/1 condition by adding a lower-strength 5/1 anchor.
Extends the m216 loading response to 150 uL in a scaffold with unusually broad predicted and measured late behavior.
Adds an intermediate m216 2/1 condition to distinguish a gradual late-tail response from an abrupt threshold.
Provides a 1/1 m216 baseline at high loading, broadening the response curve before the suspected high-strength transition.
Fills the intermediate m208 10/1 regime between weak and severe predicted tail behavior, locating onset of its broad interval.
Adds a 20/1 m208 point at moderate loading to probe curvature and loading dependence within the late-retention regime.
Provides an early m208 2/1 anchor so retraining can distinguish a condition-triggered tail from a molecule-wide offset.
Tests m204 at 10/1 with lower loading, separating the strong PE response from a possible loading-driven shift.
Adds a lower-loading m204 5/1 point to isolate amount effects below the high-retention condition.
Bridges the weak and stronger m204 conditions and targets the location of its scaffold-specific retention transition.
Creates a 5/1 m206 loading contrast at 50 uL, testing whether its broad interval grows smoothly with amount.
Samples m206 at 2/1 and low loading to locate the beginning of the fused-aromatic alcohol response.
Complements the lower-loading m206 condition with a higher-loading 2/1 point, separating condition and amount effects.
Adds a low-strength, low-loading m206 baseline for calibrating the onset of its later broad-tail regime.
Tests m22 at 20/1 and 150 uL in a high predicted interval regime, adding a chemically distinct condition-response anchor.
Adds a 5/1 m212 loading contrast to improve transfer in a sparse basic hydrogen-bonding neighborhood.
Provides a lower-condition m211 anchor below the predicted late regime, testing threshold location in a basic heteroaromatic scaffold.
Fills m211 at 20/1 and low loading to target nonlinear V2 and interval-width calibration.
Adds a chemically distinct quinoline-like HBA scaffold in a broad predicted regime, testing transfer of late-tail behavior across structure.
Samples an intermediate 10/1 m72 PE condition between weak and broad-tail regimes, locating the onset of its unusually wide interval.
Tests m72 at 20/1 and low loading, separating mobile-phase response from the effect of sample amount in a broad-interval family.
Adds an intermediate m72 5/1 PE point at high loading to improve calibration before the broad 20/1 regime.
Uses m125 with a larger loading-solvent volume to isolate loading setup from amount and condition effects in an anomalous response surface.
Adds a lower-condition, lower-amount m125 setup point to distinguish baseline loading behavior from the observed high-retention branch.
Provides a lower-condition m207 point to bracket its response before the high hydrogen-bonding aromatic regime.
Adds a 1/1 m207 baseline at high loading, improving low-regime calibration for a broad interval scaffold.
Extends the m193 condition curve to a stronger regime and targets possible V2-tail acceleration.
Adds an intermediate m39 condition in a broad-interval family, probing curvature where endpoint calibration can diverge.
Completes the m159 5/1 loading sequence at 150 uL and tests whether its recent moderate V2 residual persists at larger loading.
Adds a low-strength m159 anchor below its measured 1/1 and 2/1 conditions, improving calibration of its nonmonotone response.
Provides a low-loading m159 1/1 point to separate early loading effects from the molecule's condition response.
Extends the m160 2/1 loading curve to 150 uL, testing whether its positional-isomer response can share a loading correction.

feedback_interpretation: Recent measurements reinforce scaffold-specific condition thresholds, asymmetric V1 and V2 behavior, and mixed loading responses. Severe late-tail failures remain concentrated in particular fused, phenolic, basic, and heteroaromatic neighborhoods, while several related hydrogen-bonding scaffolds behave accurately. The next batch therefore emphasizes intermediate condition anchors, matched loading contrasts, and local transfer tests rather than a universal tail or loading correction.
batch_rationale: The batch builds several local response curves instead of selecting isolated high predictions. It targets transition locations for m216, m208, m204, m206, m212, m211, m72, m193, m207, m39, and m159; adds loading contrasts for m216, m204, m206, m212, m125, m159, and m160; and repairs chemically sparse late-tail neighborhoods with distinct fused, phenolic, and heteroaromatic scaffolds. This covers ordinary, intermediate, broad-interval, loading-sensitive, and model-failure regions, supporting better joint V1/V2 generalization across the Row-distribution after retraining.
